content.text: CI is reporting a few `unexpected any` issues in a freshly added test file
Let me look at the specific lines in the file.

content.thinking:
The issue is `(window as any)` on lines 355, 406, and 439. I need to replace these with a proper type assertion to avoid the `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` lint error.

The simplest fix is to use a more specific type or cast through `unknown`. Let me check what pattern other test files use.

content.text: All three are `(window as any).__ZUSTAND_STORES__`. The fix is to cast through `unknown` instead of using `any`.

input.new_string: const store = (window as unknown as Record<string, Record<string, { getState: () => { usedBytes: number } }>>).__ZUSTAND_STORES__?.quota;

content.content: The file /Users/michael/Code/cipher-box/tests/e2e/tests/recycle-bin.spec.ts has been updated. All occurrences of '        const store = (window as any).__ZUSTAND_STORES__?.quota;' were successfully replaced with '        const store = (window as unknown as Record<string, Record<string, { getState: () => { usedBytes: number } }>>).__ZUSTAND_STORES__?.quota;'.

+        const store = (window as unknown as Record<string, Record<string, { getState: () => { usedBytes: number } }>>).__ZUSTAND_STORES__?.quota;
if (!store) return null; // Store not accessible, skip
// Just verify store is functional (not crashed)
+        const store = (window as unknown as Record<string, Record<string, { getState: () => { usedBytes: number } }>>).__ZUSTAND_STORES__?.quota;
